config.group_selection: All eligible public benchmark/subject groups; complete groups only. At each step choose uniformly among feasible least-represented benchmarks, then uniformly among least-represented subjects within it, using seeded hash order. Counts reset within each draw; benchmark tie-breaking precedes subject selection.
config.split: Fixed item-level 50/50 pools for the pinned snapshot; odd extra to acquisition; independent fixed stream ordering.
config.responses: One fixed hash-selected recorded response for each acquired item; every binary response of evaluation items is scored.
config.checkpoints: Sequential group order within each cap, global revealed evidence, barrier before scoring all groups; no higher-cap labels exposed.
config.aliases: Stable hash aliases by public benchmark and by upstream subject ID plus visible attributes; private aliases unavailable. Distinct upstream subjects with identical visible dictionaries are retained and native predictor behavior is used.
config.known_limits: Documented-rule public-data simulation, not exact private coordinator replay. Private sampler implementation/RNG, balancing priority details, group scheduling, and recorded-response selection are unavailable; local choices above are explicit. Frozen artifacts overlap public evaluation release.
